sections.Profile:
The "High Roller Casino" pinball machine, released by Stern Pinball in 2001, brings the excitement of a Vegas casino to the arcade. Designed by Joe Balcer, John Borg, and Jon Norris, it features artwork by Kevin O'Connor and John Youssi. The game is rich with casino-themed elements, including interactive slot machines, poker hands, roulette wheels, and blackjack tables, offering a variety of gameplay modes and challenges.
